train_protocol.objective: Implement and actually train a pallet-specific image-conditioned point-line architecture and compare against the frozen paper YOLO26n under the full paper contract; superiority is unproven.

architecture.type: shared YOLO neck features + predicted-instance-conditioned line candidate distribution + differentiable anchored corner solve
architecture.feature_precision: FP16 round-trip in cache and actual inference, head/geometry FP32; AMP off
architecture.input: paper rectTrue/autoTrue/stride32/imgsz640; already-reflected training images are not padded again; P3/P4 right-bottom zero padded to80/40 with true input rectangle retained
architecture.detector_selection: top1 by confidence; GT only selects matched loss target after prediction, IoU>=.5; box/confidence/candidate order/centroid unchanged

train_protocol.loss: Per-frame supported-line soft CE + corner_weight*per-frame SmoothL1((refined-GT)/anchor_std,beta=1); center8 excluded from refinement loss.
train_protocol.sampling: Same seed-specific shuffled train-row sequence for all arms, without replacement until exhaustion; only frames with matched GT and >=1 valid corner enter loss batches. All source train records and missing/unmatched counts remain in cache/audit. No real GT or synthetic val enters optimizer.

calibration.objective: mean per-frame supported-line CE, individually per arm/seed

selection.objective: mean frame capped original-diagonal-normalized8corner error, then average3seeds; unmatched GT/missing predictions fail with1

evaluation.statistics: paired session bootstrap with same frames; report all3 training seeds and session-level intervals, not independent corners
evaluation.timing: actual complete image-to-prediction baseline vs integrated model; report overhead separately

decision.keypoint_gain: Both pooled9keypoint median and P90 improve in the three-seed mean; session-paired CI must support improvement for a confirmed claim.
decision.pose_gain: Report all four canonical6D metrics. An improvement in2D alone cannot establish pose superiority; any6D tradeoff is explicit.
decision.overall_accuracy_claim: Requires confirmed keypoint and6D gains with preserved detection/negative metrics; no claim of faster inference unless actually measured.
decision.stopping: Fixed one protocol; no real-result-driven candidate/temperature/lambda changes. Numerical bugs repaired with history preserved; repeated hypothesis failure triggers reassessment rather than endless parameter tuning.

limitations: R0 itself was trained on G38 plus legacy P0/TEX; this is not internet-only unseen-pallet evidence.
The synthetic partitions come from the existing R0 validation; some previous probes overlap. See SOURCE_DATA_AUDIT.json.
New branch training is extra compute beyond the frozen60epoch R0; geometry-only and line-only controls have matched extra budget.
Amodal structural lines are not physical edge visibility or attention.
CUDA grid_sample backward may not be bit deterministic; paired seeds are recorded.

augmentation: None added: reuse exact existing cached spatial features and canonical target coordinates
symmetry: Source/cache canonical index assignment is fixed; existing L cache/train has NO C2 min-over-permutation reassignment. P reuses those exact targets. C1/C2 diagram permutations are checked as semantic coordinate transforms, not a new training loss.
coordinates: Same label-affine letterboxed input pixels internally; original-image displacement=delta/gain; exact baseline coordinate preservation through restore_refinement
valid: Same matched train rows and per-point cached gt_valid/predicted finite sentinel mask. P has no edge endpoint/length mask since it has no edge target; per-frame supported-item reduction reused.
